data.body: **[P1] Do not change the invocation outcome after plugins are finalized.** This check runs after `ExecutionManager.close()` releases plugin instances and after `onInvocationEnd` may have emitted `PENDING` or `SUCCEEDED`. A scope fatal observed during shutdown therefore makes the invocation fail/retry while OTel and Insight retain a stale outcome. Keep plugins available through the final fatal observation and deliver one `RETRYING` snapshot before release, or preserve the already-finalized caller outcome.
